It takes twenty minutes to get to the supermarket by bike. David's favorite animal is the cat. David borrowed a book about history from the supermarket. The fitting room is at the back.
Last Thursday, David and Amy went to the supermarket. David hopes to visit Rome one day. There are always many people at the fruit shop. What's more, dad cooked steak for the family.
David drinks tea after doing sports. They took many photos at the fruit shop. David and Amy had great fun there. For example, she spread butter on the toast.
Amy is interested in singing. Life is full of small surprises. David learned a lot about history.
